projects.title: Sand binder-jet 3D printer
projects.tagline: A Voron that learned to print sand.
projects.summary: A powder-bed 3D printer that jets binder into sand, built on a Voron 2.4 motion system for a private client in the UAE. I handle the electronics, firmware, host software and bring-up.
projects.facts:
Client | Private, UAE
Process | Binder jetting into sand
Base | Voron 2.4 CoreXY
Control | Klipper + my own host software

projects.title: Kitchen-robot electronics
projects.tagline: Three years of remote R&D for a robot that cooks.
projects.summary: Remote R&D for Chefee Robotics, a US startup building a home-cooking robot: custom PCBs, firmware for the mainboard and actuators, and 20+ 3D-printed parts. At GITEX Global 2024 I represented the engineering side.
projects.facts:
Client | Chefee Robotics, US
PCBs | 3+ custom boards
Firmware | Mainboard and actuators
Printed parts | 20+
Shown at | GITEX Global 2024
projects.quote_text: Prithul spent countless hours solving puzzle after puzzle, problem after problem, designing out-of-the-box 3D models … and all while communicating progress at a very high level.

projects.title: Abhash smart-cane device
projects.tagline: Obstacle alerts for white-cane users, designed from scratch.
projects.summary: I designed Abhash from scratch: the electronics, a custom PCB and a 3D-printed enclosure, tested with real users. The team later optimized it for production, and it now has 700+ users across Bangladesh.
projects.facts:
Role | Co-founder, R&D lead
Company | Drishti Technologies, Dhaka
PCB | Custom, designed in Eagle
Enclosure | Fusion 360, 3D printed
Patent | Applied for
Users today | 700+ (production version)

projects.title: Self-driving robot car
projects.tagline: Bangladesh's first bronze at the World Robot Olympiad.
projects.summary: An autonomous robot car with computer vision and obstacle avoidance. 3rd place at the 2022 international final in Dortmund (73 countries), and 6th of 65 teams in Singapore in 2025 with a full score on the robot runs.

projects.title: ESP32 precision wattmeter
projects.tagline: Two units graph a power supply's efficiency live.
projects.summary: A precision DC wattmeter with a 24-bit ADC, dual shunts and an ESP32-S3. Two units link over Wi-Fi to graph a power supply's efficiency in real time. The design is published on GitHub and Instructables.
projects.facts:
ADC | 24-bit ADS1256
MCU | ESP32-S3
Shunts | 5 mΩ + 100 mΩ
Docs | GitHub, Instructables
